resources.string: Choose a local repository and review its current branch before running an action.

Push and Sync stage all current non-ignored changes and create a commit if needed, then upload outstanding commits. Sync first fetches and fast-forwards when safe. Conflicts, divergence and unsafe remote state stop the action. A failed upload keeps any new local commit for retry.
Local commit saved; upload was not confirmed. Review current state and retry to upload that commit.
Could not complete the action. Check connection, account, trust and folder access, then review current state before retrying.
Stopped. A Git operation may already have finished or uploaded. Review current state before retrying; saved commits and files were kept.
This review or approval is no longer current. Review the repository’s current state and confirm the action again.
Switch to a local branch and finish the active Git operation or conflict first.
Configure a remote upstream branch in Git controls before running this action.
Local changes prevent pulling incoming commits. Commit or stash them first.
Local and remote history diverged. Choose an explicit merge or rebase in Git controls.
The configured upstream branch is missing on the server. Review Git controls.
Files kept changing while staging. Review the index and files before retrying.
